about_pullquote: I started M8 Rate because I saw too many Reading families overcharged by cowboys. You deserve honest pricing and fast, quality work.
about_para_1: M8 Rate Plumbing & Heating was founded on a simple principle: get to you fast, diagnose right, and fix it properly the first time. Based in Spencers Wood, we've spent over 15 years building a reputation across Reading by showing up on time, keeping costs fair, and treating every customer's home with respect.
about_para_2: We're Gas Safe registered and insured for every job. Our customers come back because we answer the phone, we turn up when we say we will, and we explain what needs doing before we charge. Nine out of ten calls are fixed on the day—that's not luck, it's preparation and experience.
reviews_heading: What Reading Homeowners Say About M8 Rate

reviews.text: Boiler packed up just before Christmas. Called M8 Rate at 7pm on a Sunday and they were round within an hour. Fixed it on the spot, no faffing about. Fair price too. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler installed last month. The whole process was explained clearly, no hidden charges, and the work was finished exactly when they said it would be. Much warmer house now and bills are noticeably lower.
reviews.author: Catherine M.

reviews.text: Been using M8 Rate for annual servicing for three years now. Never missed a date, always professional, and they catch small problems before they become expensive ones. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael P.
